build_fully_connected_q_network: build a FullyConnected Q-network for parametric DQN with configurable layer sizes and activations
create_fully_connected_dataclass: create a FullyConnected dataclass with default layer sizes of 128 and 64 neurons
configure_batch_norm: configure the FullyConnected network to use batch normalization for training stability
configure_layer_norm: configure the FullyConnected network to use layer normalization instead of batch normalization
customize_activations: customize the FullyConnected network activations to use different functions like tanh or sigmoid
